name: Southern Utah Fall Open 2019

venue.name: [Vista Charter School](https://www.vistautah.com/)
venue.address: 585 E Center St, Ivins, UT 84738, USA
venue.details: Walk through the west doors and enter directly into the gymnasium.

information:
*  It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
*  5x5 Round 2 and 4x4 Round 2 are tentative rounds and will only take place if we get ahead of schedule. 5x5 Round 2 has a higher priority over 4x4 Round 2 and will be considered first. 
*  Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&app=desktop) will give you an overview of how a competition goes.
